titre: Le marché américain des options accélère
sous_titre: Volume quotidien moyen d'options cotées aux États-Unis, en millions de contrats par jour

T1 2025.texte: Market-wide options ADV was 68.6 million contracts in the first quarter, compared to 60.4 million in the first quarter of 2025.

2025.texte: On average, 61 million contracts traded daily with strong growth in all segments.

T1 2026.texte: Market-wide options ADV was 68.6 million contracts in the first quarter, compared to 60.4 million in the first quarter of 2025.

T2 2026.texte: 72.8 million contracts, up more than 19% from a year earlier.
